info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Loan Application Submission API
info.description: The Loan Application Submission API facilitates the submission of loan applications for processing. This endpoint enables businesses to streamline the loan application process, ensuring that submitted applications are correctly formatted and ready for evaluation. Common consumers of this API include financial institutions and loan processing systems looking to automate their application intake process. By utilizing this API, users can enhance operational efficiency and improve the overall customer experience.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to submit a loan application identified by its unique ID. After submission, the application will be processed according to the business rules established by the financial institution.

requestBody.description: Submits a loan application for processing. Ensure that all required fields in the request body are filled out accurately to avoid errors during submission.
